messages:
Darius Voss: Quick UX question from today's research: users accidentally reorder rules and want an easy undo. Also brought up: validation severity (info/warn/error) should be visible in the preview legend, not just inline chips. Any thoughts on UI patterns?

Hannah Lee: Agree - undo is essential. Suggest a non-blocking toast that appears after reorder with 'Undo' and 'View history'. Toast should be dismissible and time-limited (~8s).

Marco Ruiz: +1. Implementation note: we already track versioned rule states server-side. The toast action can call the revert endpoint. Also add a small timeline icon in the rule contextual menu for manual rollback.

Sofia Patel: For severity, we tested three variants: (A) colored left stripe + icon, (B) tiny pill with text (Info/Warn/Error), (C) legend-only (preview has color overlays and a legend). Users liked pill + legend combo. Pills need clear contrast and non-color cues (icons + tooltip).

infra-bot: Service note: revert API latency ~120-220ms for recent changes; ok for toast-driven undo. Audit log entry created on each reorder.

design-bot: Visual audit: current error red overlaps preview toggle at 375px in 6% of runs. If we move severity pill into the gutter it reduces overlap. Also recommend shape + icon for colorblind friendliness (e.g., triangle for warn, circle for info).

Darius Voss: Good. Accessibility: when undo occurs announce via aria-live: 'Change undone: rule moved back to position 3'. Also keyboard users should be able to trigger undo via a focused toast button.

Hannah Lee: Draft toast copy: 'Moved rule "Add header" back to position 3. [Undo] [View history]'. For the history modal show a compact diff view with 'Revert' button per entry.

Marco Ruiz: About history, we should cap entries visible to last 20 to avoid huge payloads. Server will return minimal deltas for the modal. Also implement optimistic UI for reorder then reconcile on server ack; show spinner in toast if commit pending.

Sofia Patel: For severity legend copy: 'Info: context-only, Warn: may affect routing, Error: prevents evaluation'. Tooltip on each pill shows the rule-specific message. Also add a 'hide severities' toggle in settings for advanced users.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure pill icons have aria-hidden and the text label is readable by screen readers (aria-label='Warning: missing condition'). Focus order: toast must be reachable via keyboard and not steal focus on appear.

Darius Voss: Action items: Hannah - comps for toast + history modal; Sofia - severity pill designs + legend; Marco - api + optimistic UX plan; infra-bot/design-bot to re-run layout & a11y checks after comps. Aim for prototype by next Tues. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
